raw_snippet: The Nvidia-backed company said Thursday that it has exceeded $1 billion in annualized revenue, five times what it had last year
dispute_text: An annualised month reported by the press or the company, not booked or audited revenue, and often sourced to the company itself.
note: Second source for the Series D figure; CNBC relaying the company. 'Exceeded $1 billion' stored as a 1.0B floor.
